name: This Time I Choose My Real Daughter
original_name: This Time I Choose My Real Daughter
overview: It is about a betrayed mother who, after giving all the love and privileges of her family to her adopted daughter, is betrayed by her and dies. Given a second chance (to be reborn or return to the past), he awakens to reality, decides to break the false daughter's manipulation and returns to claim his inheritance, unmask the impostors and unconditionally pamper his real daughter.
